subject: Aerlume Seattle AI Leaders Dinner - May 29
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congratulations on the $20m raise, that's some feat. I lead our work with
AgTech companies here at Encord, supporting teams like Aigen, Carbon
Robotics and Blue River technology, so I've been following Iunu for some
time now. We help the AI teams at these companies accelerate model
development with high-quality training data & better end-to-end pipeline
automation.

We're hosting a small dinner for AI leaders in Seattle this Thursday at
Aerlume and would love to have you join us. It's a relaxed setting to
connect over good food and conversation, and we'd love the chance to
introduce ourselves in person. We've booked a private dining room at
Aerlume this Thursday, May 29th, 6:30-9:30pm.

Let me know if you're free, and I'll send over the full details.

subject: Aerlume Seattle AI Leaders Dinner - Thurs May 29
text:
Hi [NAME] - congrats on the partnership with Aspen/Pitkin County Airport.

I lead our work with Smart City/Automation companies here at Encord,
supporting teams from Woven by Toyota, Terminal Industries and Autonomas,
so naturally I've been following Metropolis for some time now. For their AI
teams, we support them with speeding up model development and increasing
the quality of their training data with better end-to-end pipeline
automations. It's particularly critical when they expand into new use
cases/products i.e. drive-throughs.

Aerlume and would love to have you join us. It's a relaxed setting to
connect over good food and conversation, and we'd love the chance to
introduce ourselves in person. We've booked a private dining room at
Aerlume this Thursday, May 29th, 6:30-9:30pm.

Let me know if you're free, and I'll send over the full details.
